# Oshawa Heating & Cooling

> Heating and cooling requests for Oshawa. Thermostat guidance covers repair and replacement of manual, programmable, smart, and zoning controls for compatible heating and cooling systems.

Request locations: Oshawa, Ajax, Pickering, Whitby, Bowmanville, Newcastle, Courtice, Port Hope. Coverage and availability require provider confirmation.
